rules.message: Name the file for what it does, not for when it was written. A version or phase label in a filename outlives the phase.
Keep the accepted function count or extract an owned responsibility into a sibling module.
Move the shared contract to the nearest owner both modules can import.
Pass the required runtime service through the execution interface from the composition entry.
Update the affected imports with the export change, or keep the previous export until callers move.
